x: Jack WILLIAMS of Portslade, Sussex. Mrs Doris GEZZLE of Fleet, Hants. - daughter of R.W.Ricketts.
JACK WILLIAMS (220y). Aged 62, civil servant, took up Veteran Running after a 32 year rest.

Jack Williams, accompanied by his wife, came up from Brighton - he still competes in veteran sprint races. Syd King, a former Hon Treasurer and regular member of our walking training packs and teams; he too was accompanied by his wife, daughter of a former club stalwart the late Bill Redgrave.

With New Year's Day 1977 being on a Saturday we wonder what the programme will be. Amongst the spectators was Jack Williams and his wife who had travelled up from Brighton. Jack still keeps fit and indeed looks it.
Jack Williams, late of Belgrave and Veterans AC, departed from our ranks on August 6th. He joined Belgrave as a junior in the twenties and won several sprint titles.
